Focused review of commit c6fc8465611a89fd85730f0653f670d2a314a721 across the 99 bound paths identified four root-cause defects in release-authority bindings and verification/staging tooling (2 P1, 2 P2):

1. # Focused product-tooling review — lead dispositions (v0.16.2, candidate c6fc8465611a89fd85730f0653f670d2a314a721)

Class: one focused review (founder decision 2026-11-04). Resolver seats: review-daybreak-blue (strong), review-gemini-argon (strong), review-gpt-astra (focused supplement). All three completed (`verdicts.json`, `dispatch-result.json`). Reviewer findings and severities are kept unchanged below; lead re-ratings and evidence are in Rationale.

Outcome: no confirmed in-scope residual P0/P1 after lead verification. Two data-only mitigations land in the composition commit (no tooling or executable-route bytes change, so the accepted candidate's acceptance evidence stays valid). Remaining items are deferred to one follow-up issue. No fix-only round (skill: a second round runs only when the batch mitigated a confirmed P0/P1).

| ID | Reviewer severity | Lead re-rating | Disposition | Rationale (lead verification) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| DB-R1 | P1 | P3 for v0.16.2 | defer | Stager carries predecessor observed gates and the verifier checks waiver file hashes, not waiver semantics. Verified v0.16.2 `qualification.json` observed_gates: only the three current founder waivers (5090 restore_0, 4090 restore_1, 3090 sibling_1) plus the speed and rehearsal decisions; each projection carries its founder record SHA-256 (b8dac132, 01168224, edc7f226, 3d9f77cd, c169000b). The strict receipt audit dropped every predecessor waiver binding. No current instance; hardening the verifier is a tooling follow-up. |
| DB-R2 / GA-R1 | P1 / P2 | P2 | defer | Documented beta.5 upgrade reuses host `checkpoints-v013`. Verified pre-existing: published v0.16.0 QUICKSTART (tag 83e2bdd5) already sets `CHECKPOINTS="$ROOT/checkpoints-v013"` and "Keep the host directory checkpoints-v013" across its own binary upgrade, reviewed by the v0.16.0 product council. Strict origin auth binds checkpoint identity to the binary, so beta.5 never loads beta.4 checkpoints; the consequence is a colder cache after rollback, recovered by replaying authoritative OMP transcripts (documented limitation). Changing it alters executable route blocks and would invalidate acceptance; queue a successor-specific directory for the next release. |
| DB-R3 | P2 | P2 | defer | `scripts/speed_gate.py` encodes the superseded 1.08 floor and ignores normalized outputs. v0.16.2 native speed is bound from the SF-N reducer verdicts under the founder no-regression decision (`native-speed-decision.json`), and `verify_release.py --require-installable` passes; the product reducer is not on this release's path. Parameterize the rule in a follow-up. |
| DB-R4 | P2 | P2 | defer | macOS key-copy block can truncate an existing key before validating the transfer. Trusted-owner, recoverable by re-fetching the host key; fail-closed routing prevents silent cloud fallback. Executable-block change → next release. |
| GE-R1 | P1 | P2 | mitigate (data) | Identical running/rollback/repair digests under both upgrade gates. Require ready/published predecessors in a follow-up. |
